notes.title: Mansion heist patch
notes.content:
Mansion map fixes
*The car can no longer be towed while in the basement
*The car can no longer be towed through the garage door
*Guards will now be alerted if they spot the car being towed

Other fixes
*Fixed game timer inaccuracy

notes.title: Rodman research facility update
notes.content:
We’ve slightly changed the layout of the map to make it a little easier and to give you some more ways to complete the heist. A warehouse has been added to the back of the building, giving you another place to enter through. The layout of the building is still the same on the inside except for the new entrance.

The value of the beakers has also been increased to match the difficulty and length of the map.

The map has also been upgraded visually in some places by adding some more details, and changing the overall look of some areas.

notes.title: New maps and special police types!
notes.content:
The first content update for One-armed robber is here, with 2 new maps, and special police units, there is a lot to get excited about!

Maps
Liberty Hawk bank
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/dc5fac390d4b6e59313afb40935708beecd8df47.png
A small bank in the city, perfect for the inexperienced robber. This bank doesn’t have any advanced security systems, but also doesn’t contain that much cash. This bank is perfect for a novice robber learning the ropes, or an experienced robber wanting an easy challenge.

Rodman Research Facility
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/66936174f229b97f14239c8b0cf7d4fd158f2976.png
This remote research facility is developing secret chemical weapons that are worth a lot of money in the right hands! In each room is a beaker with the chemical compound, put this through the centrifuge in the laboratory to transform it into a high-value chemical weapon, which is worth a lot.

Special police units
Powerbox defuser
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/af36f4762efdad1abc8466f8713c52c50e8f77eb.png
Now with its very own special unit, the powerbox defuser does what regular police previously did; defuse powerboxes. However the special unit moves a lot faster, and is unarmed, making his only target the powerboxes, so watch out for him! turning your back to a powerbox for just a few seconds, and he might have defused it.

Juggernaut
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/b9562607f5c15aa78bca1eef68c9b3599445ab85.png
The Juggernaut unit is equipped with a heavy machine gun, and his heavy armored suit makes him incredibly difficult to get rid of, but also very slow. Shooting him through the face visor is probably your best option.

Interceptor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/d67166214d8846c02d84c5b849a698ded3b840d8.png
The Interceptor is a sneaky guy, running around placing barbed wire traps in doorways and other places. These traps will slow you down, making you an easy target for the police, shoot the barbed wire to get rid of it, and shoot the interceptor to stop him from placing barbed wire.

Shield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/c5bd62d9958e27ae88b670c845832df432458c1e.png
This unit carries a completely bulletproof shield in one hand, and wields a pistol in the other. The shield makes him very difficult to kill, however the shield has a weakness; the glass. Breaking the glass gives you direct visibility to his head, making it easy to take him out. Alternatively you can try to shoot at any limbs visible around the shield.

Blinding shield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504757/fc9fcd6f81994d3ee71b49bb4be348c2f4fa7a5f.png
very similar to the regular shield unit, except this guy has a shield equipped with extremely bright lights that will blind anyone in front of them. Try to shoot this guy before he has a chance to activate them!

notes.title: Release patch
notes.content:
The game has been out for a couple of days, and we've fixed some bugs that we missed before release, and tweaked some things to make the game easier for new players.

*New players now start with a suppressor and a lock pick, making it possible to go stealth from the beginning.

*Increased damage on secondary weapons.

*Fixed loadout not saving between games.

*An “Equip” button will now appear in the shop after buying equipment, or when selecting an “Already owned” item.

*Tools will now automatically equip after purchase, if there is an empty slot on your equipment shelf.

*Fixed “Find game” issues.

*Other minor bug fixes.
